en: Gazing at the Sacred Peak (Du Fu)

wg.en: Gazing at the Sacred Peak (Mount Tai)

t: 岱宗夫如何？齊魯青未了。
c: 岱宗夫如何？齐鲁青未了。
p: Dài zōng fú rú hé? Qí Lǔ qīng wèi liǎo.
z: ㄉㄞˋ ㄗㄨㄥ ㄈㄨˊ ㄖㄨˊ ㄏㄜˊ？ ㄑㄧˊ ㄌㄨˇ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄨㄟˋ ㄌㄧㄠˇ。
en: What is the nature of the Great Peak of Dai? Throughout Qi and Lu, its azure greenness never ends.

wg.en: The Great Peak of Dai (Mount Tai)
how is it; what is it like
Qi and Lu (ancient states in modern Shandong)

t: 造化鍾神秀，陰陽割昏曉。
c: 造化钟神秀，阴阳割昏晓。
p: Zào huà zhōng shén xiù, yīn yáng gē hūn xiǎo.
z: ㄗㄠˋ ㄏㄨㄚˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄕㄣˊ ㄒㄧㄡˋ， ㄧㄣ ㄧㄤˊ ㄍㄜ ㄏㄨㄣ ㄒㄧㄠˇ。
en: The Creator has concentrated all divine beauty here; Yin and Yang split the mountain into dusk and dawn.

wg.en: Yin and Yang (referring to the north and south slopes)

t: 盪胸生層雲，決眥入歸鳥。
c: 荡胸生层云，决眦入归鸟。
p: Dàng xiōng shēng céng yún, jué zì rù guī niǎo.
z: ㄉㄤˋ ㄒㄩㄥ ㄕㄥ ㄘㄥˊ ㄩㄣˊ， ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄗˋ ㄖㄨˋ ㄍㄨㄟ ㄋㄧㄠˇ。
en: Heaving clouds swell within my breast; I strain my eyes to follow the returning birds.

wg.en: to cleanse the chest; to agitate the breast
to strain one's eyes (literally: bursting the eye sockets)

t: 會當凌絕頂，一覽眾山小。
c: 会当凌绝顶，一览众山小。
p: Huì dāng líng jué dǐng, yī lǎn zhòng shān xiǎo.
z: ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄉㄤ ㄌㄧㄥˊ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄉㄧㄥˇ， ㄧ ㄌㄢˇ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄕㄢ ㄒㄧㄠˇ。
en: I must ascend to the very summit, and in one glance, see all other mountains as small.

wg.en: to ascend; to reach the top
one glance; to take in at a glance
